tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked elevation of creatinine and total bilirubin, with mildly decreased total protein. These findings suggest significant renal dysfunction and possible cholestasis or liver dysfunction. Other parameters are within normal limits. Correlation with clinical findings and further evaluation of renal and hepatic function are recommended.
